For the 2025 reporting year, FM Conway achieved a 19% absolute reduction in its Scope 1 and 2 carbon emissions compared with its 2019 baseline. To complement these emissions reductions, and in line with the company's Net Zero Strategy, a total of 5,749 carbon units, equivalent to 10% of the company's 2019 Scope 1 and 2 baseline footprint, have been retired. Of these, 2,224 units were retired separately by Carbon Footprint Ltd on behalf of FM Conway, while the remaining 3,525 units, recorded in this retirement statement, have been retired directly by FM Conway.

CARB43 - ClubCarby - Posto Premium (Rede Pajet) - Porto Seguro/BA

A CARB43, empresa sediada em Vitória/ES, desenvolvedora e proprietária da tecnologia denominada ClubCarby, em parceria com o Posto Premium (Rede Pajet) situado em Porto Seguro/BA, solicita a compensação de 4 toneladas de carbono - 4.000 Kg CO2 equivalente - que é significa a redução de emissões internacionalmente certificadas e é concretizado através da aposentadoria de 4 VCU (Verified Carbon Unit). Essa compensação segue em favor do projeto ambiental REDD+ Envira que atua na redução de emissões através da preservação ambiental no bioma de Floresta Amazônica. Esta compensação visa ser uma contra-partida voluntária direcionada à base de usuários ativos do ClubCarby.

Essa compensação segue em favor do projeto ambiental REDD+ Envira que atua na redução de emissões através da preservação ambiental no bioma de Floresta Amazônica. BLOOM fast good é a reinvenção do fast food e tem por propósito solucionar os dois principais problemas do setor, mantendo o prazer, emoção e praticidade trazidos pelo fast food. Dentre os dois problemas, está o impacto ambiental das cadeias atuais de fast good que predominantemente trabalham com produtos de origem animal e plástico. BLOOM é zero origem animal e zero plástico. A certificação de carbono neutro coroa este propósito da marca e nos torna a primeira marca de fast food carbono neutro das Américas. Acreditamos que não precisamos mudar aquilo que gostamos e culturalmente estamos acostumados. Não precisamos deixar aquilo que nos faz ter bons momentos. Precisamos mudar a forma de fazer e é isto que a BLOOM tem como propósito. Transformar e contribuir significativamente com as necessárias reinvenções para que combatamos de maneira correta a real ameaça das mudanças climáticas. Precisamos de união para fazer bem ao nosso Planeta e à vida.

BR Partners acredita ser possível crescer possuindo a consciência ambiental. Por isso, medidas foram tomadas ao longo do tempo para nos tornamos sustentáveis. Sempre nos questionamos sobre o que mais poderíamos fazer, nessa busca estudamos os créditos de carbono e decidimos ser mais um passo necessário para nosso crescimento.

CARB43 - ClubCarby - Posto Ideal (Rede Ventura) - Itaguaçu/ES

A CARB43, empresa sediada em Vitória/ES, desenvolvedora e proprietária da tecnologia denominada ClubCarby, em parceria com o Posto Ideal (Rede Ventura) situado no município de Itaguaçu/ES, solicita a compensação de 1 tonelada de carbono - 1.000 Kg CO2 equivalente - que é significa a redução de emissões internacionalmente certificadas e é concretizado através da aposentadoria de 1 VCU (Verified Carbon Unit). Essa compensação segue em favor do projeto ambiental REDD+ Envira que atua na redução de emissões através da preservação ambiental no bioma de Floresta Amazônica. Esta compensação visa ser uma contra-partida voluntária direcionada à base de usuários ativos do ClubCarby

A Florien Fitoativos é uma empresa do Grupo Fagron – multinacional presente em mais de 35 países e líder global em medicina personalizada. Há anos, a empresa vem implantando ações que visam reduzir os impactos na natureza e, alinhada às metas globais do Grupo Fagron para ESG (Environmental, Social and Corporate Governance), aderiu ao programa de carbono 100% negativo. A meta da Florien é fazer de tudo para mudar o futuro do mercado magistral e do planeta. Por isso, além de aderir a selos como CARBONEXT e EU RECICLO, a Florien mantém um programa institucional voltado à ações sustentáveis com seus colaboradores, o SOU FLORIEN, SOU SUSTENTÁVEL

Essa compensação segue em favor do projeto ambiental REDD+ Envira que atua na redução de emissões através da preservação ambiental no bioma de Floresta Amazônica. Esta compensação visa ser uma contrapartida voluntária direcionada à base de usuários ativos do ClubCarby.

The offsetting initiative occurred within an energy efficiency program sponsored by the electricity utility Energisa through the installation of 200 electric showers supplied by Hydra. Sky Trails Zambia was established specifically to support conservation work, and has carried out a great many hours of work in anti-poaching, wildlife surveys, logistics for conservation projects and transport of tourists to the less accessible destinations where tourism income is vital to conservation work. However, we remained with the anathema of hydrocarbon fuels being core to the operation of our business.  Remote carbon offset schemes which often had very questionable outcomes were distinctly unappealing but when the opportunity arose to offset all our carbon footprint through a project in Zambia aimed at conservation of national landscape, supporting wildlife conservation and feeding the resources through the under-developed local communities, it presented a perfect opportunity for us to become carbon neutral and thus enhance our underlying environmental objectives.

However we remained with the anathema of hydrocarbon fuels being core to the operation of our business.  Remote carbon offset schemes which often had very questionable outcomes were distinctly unappealing but when the opportunity arose to offset all our carbon footprint through a project in Zambia aimed at conservation of national landscape supporting wildlife conservation and feeding the resources through the under-developed local communities it presented a perfect opportunity for us to become carbon neutral and thus enhance our underlying environmental objectives.
Game Rangers International have offset the carbon for all of their operations both inside and outside of Zambia; including all law enforcement wildlife rescue and community outreach activities

Williams College is committed to reducing our emissions to 35% below 1990 levels by 2020, and then to achieve carbon neutrality through the purchase of offsets by the end of 2020. We intend toreduce our energy consumption on campus, invest in renewable energy developments, and participate in local\ncarbon reduction projects. Even with those strategies, there will be emissions that are difficult or impossible to eliminate locally given the College's mission and practices. We are pleased to retire 6,667 metric tonnes of tropical carbon offsets generated from the Isangi REDD+ project, which has the added benefits of providing education as well as alternative food and fuel sources as integral parts of its overall program. These will be used primarily to offset 2018 emissions related to air travel and faculty/staff commuting.

Williams College is committed to reducing our emissions to 35% below 1990 levels by 2020, and then to achieve carbon neutrality through the purchase of offsets by the end of 2020.  We intend to reduce our energy consumption on campus, invest in renewable energy developments, and participate in local carbon reduction projects.  Even with those strategies, there will be emissions that are difficult or impossible to eliminate locally given the College's mission and practices.  We are pleased to retire 6,667 metric tonnes of tropical carbon offsets generated from the Isangi REDD+ project, which has the added benefits of providing education as well as alternative food and fuel sources as integral parts of its overall program. These will be used primarily to offset emissions related to air travel and faculty/staff commuting.

Williams College is committed to reducing our emissions to 35% below 1990 levels by 2020, and then to achieve carbon neutrality through the purchase of offsets by the end of 2020.  We intend to reduce our energy consumption on campus, invest in renewable energy developments, and participate in local carbon reduction projects.  Even with those strategies, there will be emissions that are difficult or impossible to eliminate locally given the College's mission and practices.  We are pleased to retire 6,667 metric tonnes of tropical carbon offsets generated from the Isangi REDD+ project, which has the added benefits of providing education as well as alternative food and fuel sources as integral parts of its overall program. These will be used primarily to offset emissions related to air travel and faculty/staff commuting.

Loomis Chaffee School is committed to reducing our carbon emissions. We intend to reduce our energy consumption on campus invest in renewable energy developments and participate in local carbon reduction projects. Even with those strategies there will be emissions that are difficult or impossible to eliminate locally given the Schools' mission and practices. We are pleased to retire 3000 metric tonnes of tropical carbon offsets against a portion of our 2016 carbon footprint.  These offsets are generated from the Isangi REDD+ project with has added benefits of providing education as well as alternative food and fuel sources as integral parts of its overall program.

Williams College is committed to reducing our emissions to 35% below 1990 levels by 2020 and then to achieve carbon neutrality through the purchase of offsets by the end of 2020.  We intend to reduce our energy consumption on campus invest in renewable energy developments and participate in local carbon reduction projects.  Even with those strategies there will be emissions that are difficult or impossible to eliminate locally given the College’s mission and practices.  We are pleased to retire 6667 metric tonnes of tropical carbon offsets generated from the Isangi REDD+ project which has the added benefits of providing education as well as alternative food and fuel sources as integral parts of its overall program. These will be used primarily to offset emissions related to air travel and faculty/staff commuting.
